title: Grade 10 Chemistry National Exam & Practice 2024 (6 Chapters Combined)
description: Comprehensive examination bank combining 6 chapters (100 questions). Official Ethiopian national curriculum.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a chemical change?
questions.explanation: Rusting of iron is a chemical change because it forms a new substance (iron oxide).

questions.questionText: Which of the following represents a balanced chemical equation?
questions.explanation: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O has equal numbers of atoms on both sides, so it is balanced.

questions.questionText: Which type of reaction is 2Na + Cl₂ → 2NaCl?
questions.explanation: Two elements combine to form a compound, so it is a combination reaction.

questions.questionText: In Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂, zinc is:
questions.explanation: Zinc loses electrons to form Zn²⁺, so it is oxidized.

questions.questionText: Which is an example of a displacement reaction?
questions.explanation: Zinc displaces copper from copper sulfate, which is a displacement reaction.

questions.questionText: Molecular mass of H₂O is:
questions.explanation: H₂O has 2 H (2×1) + 1 O (16) = 18 g/mol.

questions.questionText: One mole of any substance contains how many particles?
questions.explanation: One mole contains Avogadro’s number of particles: 6.022×10²³.

questions.questionText: 2KClO₃ → 2KCl + 3O₂ is an example of:
questions.explanation: Potassium chlorate decomposes into potassium chloride and oxygen.

questions.questionText: In 2Fe₂O₃ + 3C → 4Fe + 3CO₂, carbon is:
questions.explanation: Carbon is oxidized to CO₂.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a redox reaction?
questions.explanation: Zinc is oxidized and copper is reduced; both oxidation and reduction occur.

questions.questionText: Formula mass of Na₂CO₃ is:
The mole concept helps relate:
questions.explanation: The mole allows calculation between mass, number of particles, and molar relationships.

questions.questionText: 2Al + 3Cl₂ → 2AlCl₃ is an example of:
questions.explanation: Two reactants form one product, so it is combination.

questions.questionText: Stoichiometry helps calculate:
questions.explanation: It calculates amounts of reactants and products based on the balanced equation.

questions.questionText: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, how many moles of H₂O form from 4 moles of H₂?
questions.explanation: 4 moles H₂ react to form 4 moles H₂O according to the ratio 2:2.

questions.questionText: Which is a double displacement reaction?
questions.explanation: Ag⁺ and Na⁺ exchange ions with Cl⁻ and NO₃⁻; it’s a double displacement.

questions.questionText: Which represents oxidation?
questions.explanation: Zinc loses electrons, which is oxidation.

questions.questionText: Which shows reduction?
questions.explanation: Copper gains electrons to form Cu; reduction occurs.

questions.questionText: Molecular mass of CO₂ is:
questions.explanation: C=12, O₂=16×2=32; total=44 g/mol.

questions.questionText: 1 mole of NaCl contains:
questions.explanation: One mole contains Avogadro’s number of formula units: 6.022×10²³.

questions.questionText: Which reaction is endothermic?
questions.explanation: Decomposition of CaCO₃ absorbs heat.

questions.questionText: Which reaction is exothermic?
questions.explanation: Formation of water releases energy; exothermic reaction.

questions.questionText: Mass of 2 moles H₂O is:
questions.explanation: 1 mole H₂O = 18 g; 2 moles = 36 g.

questions.questionText: In 2K + Br₂ → 2KBr, bromine is:
questions.explanation: Bromine gains electrons to form Br⁻; reduction occurs.

questions.questionText: Mole ratio in N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃ is:
questions.explanation: 1 mole N₂ reacts with 3 moles H₂ to form 2 moles NH₃.

questions.questionText: Which reaction shows reduction of Cu?

questions.explanation: 2 moles × 6.022×10²³ = 1.204×10²⁴ units.

questions.explanation: Sodium displaces hydrogen from water; this is a single displacement reaction.

questions.explanation: Protons carry a positive charge.

questions.explanation: Molar mass of H₂O = 18 g/mol; 36 ÷ 18 = 2 moles.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an endothermic reaction?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis absorbs energy from sunlight; it is endothermic.

questions.questionText: Which of the following reactions releases oxygen gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen peroxide decomposes to form water and oxygen gas.

questions.questionText: Which reaction is an example of a synthesis reaction?
questions.explanation: Two reactants combine to form one product; this is synthesis.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a chemical property?
questions.explanation: Flammability describes the ability to undergo chemical change.

questions.questionText: Which reaction produces a precipitate?
questions.explanation: AgCl forms as a solid precipitate.

questions.questionText: How many electrons are there in a neutral atom of sodium?
questions.explanation: Sodium has 11 protons; in neutral atom, electrons = 11.

options: Number of atoms in 12 g of carbon
questions.explanation: 12 g of carbon contains 1 mole of atoms; mole concept is applied.

questions.explanation: Combustion reactions release heat and energy; exothermic.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a heterogeneous mixture?
questions.explanation: Sand does not dissolve and is visibly separate; heterogeneous mixture.

questions.questionText: Which particle in the atom determines its identity?
questions.explanation: Number of protons defines the element.

questions.questionText: Which reaction is a single replacement reaction?
questions.explanation: Chlorine replaces iodine in potassium iodide; single replacement.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct mole ratio in N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃?
questions.explanation: 1 mole N₂ reacts with 3 moles H₂ to form 2 moles NH₃.

questions.questionText: Which of the following shows a compound containing covalent bonds?
questions.explanation: CO₂ has covalent bonds formed by sharing electrons between C and O atoms.

questions.questionText: Which law explains that elements combine in fixed ratios to form compounds?
questions.explanation: The law of definite proportions states that a chemical compound always contains exactly the same proportion of elements by mass.

questions.questionText: Which of the following reactions is endothermic?
questions.explanation: Decomposition of CaCO₃ absorbs heat from surroundings; it is endothermic.

questions.questionText: Which particle is responsible for the chemical behavior of an element?
questions.explanation: Electrons, especially valence electrons, determine chemical reactions and bonding.

questions.questionText: Which type of reaction occurs when an acid reacts with a metal to produce hydrogen gas?
questions.explanation: Metal displaces hydrogen from the acid; this is a single displacement reaction.

questions.questionText: How many moles are present in 88 g of CO₂?
questions.explanation: Molar mass of CO₂ = 44 g/mol; 88 ÷ 44 = 2 moles.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a heterogeneous chemical system?
questions.explanation: Oil does not dissolve in water and forms separate layers; heterogeneous system.

questions.questionText: Which reaction involves the transfer of electrons?
questions.explanation: Zinc loses electrons and copper ions gain electrons; redox reaction occurs.

questions.questionText: Which of the following reactions produces water as a product?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen reacts with oxygen to form water; synthesis reaction.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a characteristic of a chemical change?
questions.explanation: Color change indicates a chemical reaction and formation of a new substance.
